visible_text: 決まったことが出たら、ここに並びます
やることが出たら、ここに並びます
まだ発話がありません。
この会議について聞く

answers.q1: Mostly one surface, but the small black pill toolbar at the very top (record dot, pause, comment, expand, more, stop) sits detached from the white card below it — it overlaps the card's top edge with its own rounded shape and shadow, reading like a separate floating mini-window rather than part of the card. Everything else (left transcript column, right panel with tabs, bottom input bar, 'AI が見ている資料' link) is contained in one continuous white rounded card.
answers.q2: Only partially. It shows a generic title '23:33 の会議' (a timestamp, not a named meeting) and a status 'listening...', so I know it's an active recording, but there's no participant list, calendar event, or specific source named — I can't tell who is in the meeting or what material it's drawing from beyond the vague 'AI が見ている資料' link at the bottom, which itself shows no content yet.
answers.q3: It's actively recording audio (00:02 elapsed) and listening for speech. It's waiting for someone to talk — the transcript panel says 'まだ発話がありません' (no speech yet), and the summary/decisions/action-item sections are all empty placeholders waiting to populate once conversation happens.
answers.q4: The recording status indicator ('録音中 00:02') combined with the empty transcript panel — it's the clearest signal of what's actually happening right now: the app is live and capturing, but nothing has been said yet.
answers.q5: The floating black pill toolbar at top is unclear — several icons (comment bubble, expand, three-dot menu) have no labels so their function isn't obvious. The four bottom-right action buttons (リアルタイム要約/質問する/決定事項/アクション) are grayed out with no explanation of why they're disabled or when they'll activate. The repeated placeholder sentences ('〜が出たら、ここに並びます') are a bit redundant given the empty-state is already obvious from the blank space below them.

weaknesses.what: The top black pill toolbar overlaps and floats above the main card's edge instead of being docked inside it, reading as a separate overlay window stacked on the app rather than part of it.
weaknesses.fix: Embed the toolbar as a header row inside the card's own rounded boundary so the whole surface reads as one shape.

weaknesses.what: The only identifier for the meeting is a bare timestamp title ('23:33 の会議'); no participants, calendar name, or connected source is visible, so a first-time viewer can't tell what is actually being recorded.
weaknesses.fix: Surface the meeting/event name or participant names if known, and show a preview of the linked material under 'AI が見ている資料' instead of leaving it unexplained.

weaknesses.what: The four action buttons (リアルタイム要約, 質問する, 決定事項, アクション) are grayed out with no visible reason or hint for when they become active.
weaknesses.fix: Add a short disabled-state hint (e.g. 'available once there is a transcript') or tooltip.
